title: Product Map: lazy first-load payload
asA: a reviewer opening the review surface on a slow link
iWant: an initial HTML payload well under 3 MB by rendering only the active grouping fully and hydrating the other groupings on demand from a partial endpoint

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Product Map first-load payload target is well under 3 MB. The server emits the shape (default) grouping fully; the other three groupings emit only their bucket headings (label + total count + per-status mini counts) and each bucket carries a data-pm-lazy marker naming its grouping and bucket id. When the reader switches to a lazy grouping OR opens a lazy bucket, the client fetches that grouping fully once (from a partial endpoint the server exposes) and hydrates the bucket into the DOM; subsequent switches use the cached partial. The pass doc states the before/after first-load bytes.
